ClassifyCommodity.title: Product Categorization
ClassifyCommodity.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the ClassifyCommodity operation for product categorization.
ClassifyCommodity.description:
## Feature Description  
The product categorization feature can detect the category of a product in an image and return information such as the product category and confidence level. It currently supports over 6,000 categories across scenarios including apparel, footwear, bags, consumer electronics, and household goods.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=goodstech&children=ClassifyCommodity) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence API capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Product Category  
Click [Enumerated Categories](https://viapi-demo.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/doc/category.txt?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.16.2c1d687bEDtrmY&file=category.txt) to view the list of currently supported product categories.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Enable the capability**:  
   - Ensure you have activated the [Product Understanding service](https://vision.aliyun.com/goodstech). If not, activate it immediately by clicking [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_goodstech_public_cn#/open).  
   - After activation, [submit a request](https://vision.console.aliyun.com/cn-shanghai/applyopen/goodstech/ClassifyCommodity). You can use the feature only after your request is approved.  

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/goodstech/2019-12-30/ClassifyCommodity?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fgoodstech%2FClassifyCommodity%2FClassifyCommodity1.jpg%22%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred programming language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "Product Understanding" (`goodstech`).  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Product Categorization Sample Code](~~601099~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation include:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Image formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 3 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: There is no strict limit on resolution; however, excessively high resolution may cause API timeout. The timeout period is 5 seconds.  
- **URL requirements**: The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of product categorization, see [Billing Introduction](~~202477~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid interface. For a free debugging experience, go to the [Experience Center](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=goodstech&children=ClassifyCommodity).
ClassifyCommodity.responseParamsDescription:
## SDK Reference  
Alibaba Cloud Vision AI's product categorization capability under the Product Understanding category is recommended to be invoked using a software development kit (SDK). It supports multiple programming languages. When invoking this capability, select the SDK package with the AI category set to Product Understanding (goodstech). The file parameter supports both local files and arbitrary URLs when called through the SDK. For more information, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [Product Categorization Sample Code](~~601099~~).
ClassifyCommodity.extraInfo:
## Error Codes  
For error codes related to product categorization, see [Common Error Codes](~~146738~~).

## Security Statement  
- Ensure that the source of the uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debug testing are valid for 1 hour and will be automatically deleted by the system after 24 hours.
